name: hippo
label: HiPPO
line: Memory as the optimal polynomial projection of the past, updated by a closed-form linear ODE.

name: linattn
label: Linear attention
line: Kernel feature map replaces softmax; causal attention becomes an RNN with a fixed-size matrix state.

name: s4
label: S4
line: HiPPO A as normal plus low-rank; the convolution kernel is computed cheaply via a Cauchy kernel and FFT.

name: lru
label: LRU
line: Linear complex-diagonal RNN with exponential parameterization and normalization matches S4 on LRA without HiPPO.

name: mamba
label: Mamba
line: Selection: Delta, B, C depend on the input; computed by a fused hardware-aware parallel scan.

name: zoology
label: Zoology
line: Most of the perplexity gap between gated convolutions and attention is associative recall; introduces MQAR.

name: vim
label: Vim
line: ViT-style patch sequence scanned forward and backward by two selective SSMs per block.

name: vmamba
label: VMamba
line: SS2D cross-scan: four scan routes over the patch grid, merged so every patch sees all others.

name: repeat
label: Repeat After Me
line: Proves fixed-state models are limited at copying, while two-layer transformers copy exponentially long strings.

name: jamba
label: Jamba
line: Interleaves attention and Mamba layers 1:7, MoE every other layer; KV cache 8x smaller.

name: mamba2
label: Mamba-2
line: Scalar-A selective SSM equals masked linear attention (SSD); a chunked matmul algorithm allows larger states.

name: nvidia-mamba
label: NVIDIA Mamba study
line: Same-data 8B comparison: pure Mamba/Mamba-2 lag on copying and in-context learning; Mamba-2-Hybrid beats Transformer.

name: parscan
label: Linear RNN scan
line: Linear recurrences are scans: Blelloch's parallel scan trains them in log depth over sequence length.

headline.text: up to 9x faster training and inference of linear RNNs

name: lssl
label: LSSL
line: Plugs HiPPO's A into a time-invariant state space; one layer is continuous, recurrent and convolutional.

name: dss
label: DSS
line: Drops S4's low-rank correction: a purely diagonal state matrix matches S4 on Long Range Arena.

name: s4d
label: S4D
line: Diagonal A with S4's other choices; kernel is a Vandermonde product, and the HiPPO-derived init is what matters.

name: hippo2
label: HiPPO-2 (HTTYH)
line: Explains S4's HiPPO matrix as projection onto exponentially-warped Legendre polynomials; adds Fourier variants and timescale init.

headline.text: S4 improved to 86% on Long Range Arena

name: s5
label: S5
line: Replaces S4's many single-input SSMs with one multi-input, multi-output SSM computed by a parallel scan.

name: h3
label: H3
line: Stacks a shift SSM and a diagonal SSM with multiplicative gates, shaped like linear attention, for recall.

headline.loc: Table 2, row H3, column Associative Recall

name: hyena
label: Hyena
line: Replaces attention with implicitly parameterized long convolutions interleaved with data-controlled gating.
reading_note: h3 link is our reading; the abstract names no parent model

headline.text: Hyena operator faster than optimized attention at sequence length 64K

name: rwkv
label: RWKV
line: Linear-attention-style RNN that trains in parallel like a Transformer and decodes with constant memory.

headline.text: largest model, 'by far the largest dense RNN ever trained'

name: retnet
label: RetNet
line: Retention: one mechanism with parallel, recurrent and chunkwise-recurrent forms, giving O(1) inference per token.
reading_note: linattn link is our reading; the abstract derives 'the connection between recurrence and attention' without naming linear attention

name: gla
label: GLA
line: Adds data-dependent gates to linear attention, trained with an I/O-aware kernel (FlashLinearAttention).

headline.text: trained on 2K, generalizes to sequences longer than 20K

name: based
label: Based
line: Combines linear attention with sliding-window attention; window and feature size dial state size versus recall.

headline.text: higher generation throughput than FlashAttention-2 (1024 tokens, 1.3b)

name: griffin
label: Griffin
line: Real-valued, input-gated LRU recurrence (RG-LRU); Hawk is purely recurrent, Griffin adds local attention.

name: illusion
label: Illusion of State
line: Proves S4- and Mamba-style SSMs lie in TC^0, like transformers, so they cannot express permutation composition.

name: xlstm
label: xLSTM
line: Scales LSTM with exponential gating; sLSTM keeps scalar memory, mLSTM a parallelizable matrix memory.

name: mambaout
label: MambaOut
line: Removes the SSM from Mamba blocks (Gated CNN); beats visual Mambas on ImageNet, trails on detection/segmentation.

name: mlla
label: MLLA (MILA)
line: Recasts Mamba as linear attention with six differences; forget gate and block design matter most.

name: zamba
label: Zamba
line: 7B Mamba backbone plus a single shared attention module, for attention's benefits at minimal parameter cost.

name: deltanet
label: DeltaNet
line: Parallelizes delta-rule linear attention (DeltaNet) over sequence length using a Householder-product representation.

headline.text: model size trained for 100B tokens; beats Mamba and GLA

name: samba
label: Samba
line: Layer-wise mix of Mamba and sliding-window attention, aimed at unlimited-context language modeling in linear time.

headline.text: higher throughput than GQA Transformers on 128K-token prompts

name: mambavision
label: MambaVision
line: Hierarchical vision backbone: a redesigned Mamba mixer, with self-attention blocks in the final layers.

name: jamba15
label: Jamba-1.5
line: Jamba block scaled to 94B active / 398B total; ExpertsInt8 fits 256K context on 8 80GB GPUs.

name: minrnn
label: minLSTM/minGRU
line: Simplifies LSTM and GRU into minimal versions with fewer parameters that train fully in parallel.

name: hymba
label: Hymba
line: Hybrid-head parallel design: attention heads and SSM heads side by side, plus learnable meta tokens.
reading_note: mamba link is our reading; the abstract says 'SSMs' without naming Mamba

name: gdn
label: Gated DeltaNet
line: Gated delta rule: Mamba-2's decay gate erases memory, the delta rule rewrites single key-value pairs.

headline.loc: Table 3, row Gated DeltaNet, column Avg.

name: nemotronh
label: Nemotron-H
line: Mamba-2 hybrids at 8B and 56B; roughly 8% of layers are attention, the rest Mamba-2 and FFN.

headline.text: up to 3x faster inference than similar-size Transformers

name: falconh1
label: Falcon-H1
line: Parallel hybrid: attention and SSMs combined side by side, released from 0.5B to 34B parameters.
reading_note: mamba2 link is our reading; the abstract says 'SSMs' and names Mamba only for earlier Falcon models

headline.text: Falcon-H1-34B matches or outperforms models up to 70B

name: mamba3
label: Mamba-3
line: Exponential-trapezoidal discretization, complex-valued (RoPE-like) state, and MIMO updates on top of Mamba-2; no short conv.
